title: FBI Photo B5
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military sensor system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as part of a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: Extreme redaction: the extracted text from the PDF is almost entirely garbled/unreadable, suggesting heavy redaction or OCR failure on a heavily obscured image.
No mission report was provided alongside the image, removing operational context.
The image date/time stamp is confirmed inaccurate by the submitting agency.
The imagery was pre-redacted by the FBI before AARO received it, meaning AARO and the public are working from an altered version.
Single-source submission with no corroborating sensor data or witness testimony provided.
The narrative description explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment or factual determination.
No distinct objects are clearly visible in the image, making independent analysis extremely limited.
